changes_made: Captured pre-call values via plain let bindings: old_self_value, old_other_value (u64, copyable), and old_pool_id (ID, copyable) — `other` is consumed by the call, so its value is captured before
Added ensures verifying the core accounting effect: self.value == old(self.value) + old(other.value), expressed in Integer arithmetic via .to_int().add()
Added frame-condition ensures: self.pool_id unchanged (old_pool_id), guarding against unintended pool identity mutation
Bumped @VERIFY annotation from (🛡️/✅) ASSERTS to (⚙️/✅) SEMANTICS
issues: Used plain `let` bindings instead of clone! since both getters return copyable scalars (u64/ID), not struct references — clone! is unnecessary and a let binding is the correct idiom for the capture-before/ensure-after accounting pattern here.
Both abort preconditions (same-pool, no-overflow) remain asserted; ignore_abort is NOT used. All three phases pass — _Check, _Assume (abort coverage), and _SpecNoAbortCheck (spec body abort-free).
